scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/api-server" --filter "./artifacts/mockup-sandbox" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: TEST_API_PORT=${TEST_API_PORT:-18080} TEST_WEB_PORT=${TEST_WEB_PORT:-31561} TEST_OPENAI_MOCK_PORT=${TEST_OPENAI_MOCK_PORT:-28081} playwright test tests/e2e/hardening.spec.ts tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts
scripts.test:mutate: echo 'Install @stryker-mutator/* and run: npx stryker run' && npx --yes stryker run || true
scripts.test:qa: pnpm run typecheck && REQUIRE_REDIS=${REQUIRE_REDIS:-1} pnpm run test:hardening && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:e2e:smoke
